title: A repeated submission updates one signup instead of duplicating it
description:
**Phase 1 of 5.**

- **Blocked by:** the survey submission story
- **Runs in parallel with:** the confirmation story
- **Unblocks:** nothing

---
People fill the survey twice: they abandon and come back, they change an answer, they forget they already applied. The record is keyed by normalized work email, the same way the identity kernel normalizes email in org_records.py — lowercase and strip, dots and plus-tags kept exactly.

Without this, the operator queue fills with the same person three times and every conversion number is wrong.

**Done when:** the scenarios exist and fail for the right reason.

comments.text:
Feature: Waitlist survey submission

  Scenario: A second submission from one email updates the first
    Given a waitlist signup exists for "sam@example.com"
    When a survey is submitted again for "SAM@example.com"
    Then one waitlist signup exists for "sam@example.com"
    And it carries the answers from the second submission

  Scenario: Completing an abandoned survey fills in the same signup
    Given an incomplete waitlist signup exists for "sam@example.com"
    When that visitor returns and completes the survey
    Then one waitlist signup exists for "sam@example.com"
    And it is no longer marked incomplete

comments.text: Closed as obsolete in this repo (board cleanup 2026-10-20). The waitlist, survey and contact intake moved to the private repo AnthusAI/Chattic.us-web (PR 24, merged; its own Lambda, DynamoDB table and SES, live since 2026-10-15). The Python control plane this ticket targeted was removed here (PR 467).  Signups there are keyed by trimmed, lowercased email and a resubmission before confirmation updates the one record.
